need.query: Prepare a shared contact and meeting plan, keep an accessible paper copy, and check it with household members.

claims.text: Texas DSHS recommends a written shared plan with local and out-of-town contacts and meeting places; it offers a printable form and notes that messaging may work during phone disruption.

candidates.name: Make a household communication plan
candidates.reason: Prepare a shared contact and meeting plan, keep an accessible paper copy, and check it with household members.
